subject: reasoning
question:
Observe the dots on a dice (one to six dots) in the following figures. How many dots are contained on the face opposite to that containing six dots? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/826f6b93c055be025ab2b25dc04979b72d3a27ae0a311f312dde9962c6a58160.png]
solution:
To find the opposite surface of 'six dots', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4641e2e21d74db45e90c79f78336bce4a4f68f75cf82783556a51ae58ffd60a2.png] 

From both dices, one and two dots are common. So, remaining surface will be opposite to each other.

So, 'Three' dots will be the opposite face of 'Six dots'.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Three**"
